title: Core asks the engine whether a local model can use tools
goal: CEO direction 2026-11-12 ("fix it and finish the end-to-end run"). Found while preparing the end-to-end run of T-CLAUDELOCALTOOLS-1: `ModelManager::supports_tool_calling` returned false for every whole GGUF, because the lexical template check lost its GGUF reader when the engine left core. Every local request with `requires: "tools"` was therefore refused with `[CAPABILITY_GAP]` before reaching the engine, and no local model could ever be selected for tools. Core now asks the local engine plug on `gpu_fabric.local_engine.model_capabilities` (`{"path"}` -> `{"tools": bool}`). A real answer is cached per (path, length, mtime) under a new probe name, so old `false` verdicts are not reused; no engine attached, or no answer, is unknown: `false` and not cached.

results.end_to_end: 2026-11-12, isolated instance (scratch SUSI_HOME, SUSI_PORT_OFFSET=7300), core daemon built from this change, commercial `susi-plug-host` (release) built from T-CLAUDECOMMTOOLCAP-1, audited starter qwen2.5-0.5b-instruct-q4_0.gguf. (1) No plug host: a tools request fails with `inference_exhausted`. (2) Plug host attached, plain chat over POST /v1/chat/completions: "The capital of France is Paris." (plug log: infer_stream ok in 4,063 ms). (3) Same endpoint with `susi.requires = "tools"`: plug log shows `model_capabilities -> ok in 12 ms` then `infer_stream -> ok in 152,246 ms`; the model emitted a tool call, core dispatched it (`[TOOL benchmark_run]`) and returned the tool's output with finish_reason stop. Before this change step (3) would end in `[CAPABILITY_GAP]`.

limitations: The tools request took 152 s: core sends up to 32 tool schemas and the 0.5B model runs on the pure-Rust CPU engine. The prose list core used to send is shorter; whether to send fewer or smaller schemas is open.
The 0.5B model chose an unrelated tool (`benchmark_run`) for a weather question, and core ran it. Tool choice quality is the model's; the dispatch is core's existing policy-gated path.
Asking the engine is one bus round trip per uncached model file on the routing path.
